shots.prompt: Wide shot inside an old agricultural seed storage room at night: on all four walls, grey steel shelving units reaching the ceiling, packed with thousands of small kraft-paper seed envelopes standing in neat rows, each with a small handwritten label. In the middle of the room, an old wooden desk with {lamp} glowing — the only warm light — and a white-haired old man in a worn grey wool sweater sitting at the desk with his back to the camera, his face not visible. Camera slightly above the lamp height, looking down across the room. Deep shadows, warm pool of lamp light, cinematic, quiet.

Inside an agricultural research station drying room: rows of horizontal galvanized metal drying bars, each hung with many bunches of ripe golden foxtail millet heads hanging head-down, thick bristly cylindrical panicles. Strong late-afternoon sunlight streams in from high windows behind the racks: backlight makes the bristles glow with a golden halo, visible shafts of light full of drifting dust. Camera low, looking slightly up along the rows. Quiet, reverent, cinematic. Absolutely no people, no human figures anywhere in the frame — only the racks, the millet, the light and the dust.
